_note: Domains of lenders regulated by the RBI (banks and NBFCs) and their digital lending apps. Used to spot the loan-app scam pattern: an app or site promising instant credit that belongs to no regulated lender.
_provenance: SEED LIST, compiled by hand from the public websites of well-known RBI-regulated entities. It is NOT a copy of the RBI Digital Lending Apps directory and is deliberately incomplete.
_before_real_use: Replace with the current DLA list RBI publishes for its regulated entities (rbi.org.in). Because this list is partial, a domain missing from it is reported as 'not verified against our list' and scored as suspicious -- never as proof that a lender is illegitimate.
